description: Calibrate the mitochondrial-presequence features against human reference sets and score ADPRHL1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
        K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def hmoment(s,delta=100.0):
    a=np.deg2rad(delta)*np.arange(len(s)); h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0) for c in s])
    return float(np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/max(len(s),1))
def feats(s,n=30):
    seg=s[:n]
    return dict(acidic=sum(c in 'DE' for c in seg), basic=sum(c in 'KR' for c in seg),
                netQ=sum(c in 'KR' for c in seg)-sum(c in 'DE' for c in seg),
                meanKD=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in seg])), hmom=hmoment(seg),
                RLS=sum(c in 'RLS' for c in seg)/len(seg))

def up(q,size=500,fields="accession,protein_name,sequence,length"):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":size,"fields":fields,"format":"json"},timeout=55)
    r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()["results"]

# POSITIVE controls: human reviewed proteins with an experimentally annotated mitochondrial transit peptide
pos=up("(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transit:*) AND (cc_scl_term:SL-0178)",size=400)
# NEGATIVE controls: human reviewed cytosolic proteins with no transit peptide and no signal peptide
neg=up("(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (cc_scl_term:SL-0091) NOT (ft_transit:*) NOT (ft_signal:*)",size=400)
P=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],**feats(e["sequence"]["value"])) for e in pos]); P['cls']='mito matrix (transit peptide)'
N=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],**feats(e["sequence"]["value"])) for e in neg]); N['cls']='cytosol (no transit/signal)'
ref=pd.concat([P,N],ignore_index=True)
print("Calibration sets: %d mitochondrial-matrix transit-peptide proteins, %d cytosolic proteins"%(len(P),len(N)))

TRI={'ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)':'Q8NDY3','ARH1/ADPRH (P54922)':'P54922','ARH3/ADPRHL2 (Q9NX46)':'Q9NX46'}
T={k:requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta",timeout=40).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","") for k,v in TRI.items()}
tri=pd.DataFrame({k:feats(v) for k,v in T.items()}).T
print("\nQuery proteins:"); print(tri.round(3).to_string())

print("\nReference distributions (residues 1-30):")
print(ref.groupby('cls')[['acidic','netQ','meanKD','hmom','RLS']].describe().T.round(2).to_string())

# Empirical percentile of each query in the two reference distributions
print("\nPercentile of each query within each reference class:")
out=[]
for k in tri.index:
    for cls,g in ref.groupby('cls'):
        out.append(dict(query=k, ref=cls,
            pct_acidic=round(100*(g.acidic<tri.loc[k,'acidic']).mean(),1),
            pct_netQ=round(100*(g.netQ<tri.loc[k,'netQ']).mean(),1),
            pct_meanKD=round(100*(g.meanKD<tri.loc[k,'meanKD']).mean(),1)))
print(pd.DataFrame(out).to_string(index=False))

# Simple 2-feature logistic classifier as a transparent MTS discriminant
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
X=ref[['acidic','netQ','meanKD','hmom','RLS']].values; y=(ref.cls.str.startswith('mito')).astype(int).values
clf=LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000).fit(X,y)
cv=cross_val_score(LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000),X,y,cv=5,scoring='roc_auc')
print("\nLogistic MTS discriminant, 5-fold CV ROC-AUC = %.3f (sd %.3f)"%(cv.mean(),cv.std()))
pr=clf.predict_proba(tri[['acidic','netQ','meanKD','hmom','RLS']].values)[:,1]
for k,p in zip(tri.index,pr): print(f"  P(mitochondrial presequence) for {k:22s} = {p:.3f}")
print("  reference medians: mito %.3f | cytosol %.3f"%(np.median(clf.predict_proba(X[y==1])[:,1]),
                                                       np.median(clf.predict_proba(X[y==0])[:,1])))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.2))
for a,(col,lab) in zip(ax,[('acidic','Acidic residues (D+E) in residues 1-30'),
                           ('meanKD','Mean Kyte-Doolittle, residues 1-30'),
                           ('netQ','Net charge, residues 1-30')]):
    for cls,g,c in [('mito matrix (transit peptide)',ref[ref.cls.str.startswith('mito')],'#C4553B'),
                    ('cytosol (no transit/signal)',ref[ref.cls.str.startswith('cytosol')],'#2F6DB5')]:
        a.hist(g[col],bins=25,alpha=.55,label=cls,color=c,density=True)
    a.axvline(tri.loc['ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)',col],color='k',lw=2.2,ls='--',label='ADPRHL1')
    a.axvline(tri.loc['ARH3/ADPRHL2 (Q9NX46)',col],color='#7B3F9E',lw=2.2,label='ARH3')
    a.set_xlabel(lab); a.set_ylabel('density')
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle('ADPRHL1 sits in the cytosolic reference distribution, ARH3 in the mitochondrial-presequence distribution',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
ref.to_csv('/agent/jobs/473cf4f5-f325-4c57-88f5-9278c2613938/provenance/mts_calibration_reference.csv',index=False)
